profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at TIAG®
profile.summary: I am a dedicated person who enjoys working with other engineers to create something new that will demonstrate our hard work, quality, durance and passion on what I do.

positions.title: Computer Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Debugging · Software Troubleshooting · Computer Science

positions.title: Senior Project
positions.description:
My senior project was to construct a projectile launcher using GPS and other sensors to calculate distance and other variables to accurately hit a target with a 1-meter radius.
The team was divided into two sub teams hardware, and software.
As the project manager of the software side I was in charged of getting updates of each of the members weekly tasks, and reporting those updates to our sponsor/mentor from Cubic Inc.
I was working on embedded systems, programing PIC16 microcontrollers to receive and process data coming from different sensor using C language, UART communication, and MPLab interface. 
I also had to interact with the project manager of the hardware side to discuss our goals and expectation in order to successfully accomplish our milestones.
